critical_code_review_comments: All 35 Stock-Out Analysis test cases PASS
Stock-Out identification correctly uses: SOH=0 AND ROS>0 formula
Daily Sales Loss correctly calculates: ((ROS × 1) - SOH) × ASP
Severity correctly calculates: LostSales × Duration × Importance
All trend arrays (daily, weekly, monthly, WTD, MTD, QTD, YTD) present and functional
Heatmap grid with color-coded severity and drill-down panel working
High-risk SKUs correctly identified with days_to_stockout = SOH / ROS
Reorder recommendations use config-driven lead_time (14 days) and safety_days (7 days)
All data-testid attributes present for automated testing

success_rate.frontend: 100% - All 4 tabs and controls verified working
